subject: Improve CSAT and FCR with targeted CX pilots
body:
I noticed Salesforce's Q2 FY26 results and thought these CX insights could inform your upcoming initiatives. With rising subscription and support revenue, there's an opportunity to channel incremental budget into contact center, omnichannel, and self‑service improvements that support CSAT, agent productivity, and first contact resolution.

- Record Q2 FY26: Subscription & Support growth broadens funding for CX priorities, including contact center investments.
- Zero Copy Partner Network: real‑time, bidirectional Data Cloud integration reduces agent context switching and supports omnichannel consistency to improve FCR.
- Agentforce Conversational AI: customizable assistants and APIs can automate routine intents, extend self‑service, and accelerate agent workflows.

If useful, I can send a one‑page brief on quick pilots or continue via email — or schedule a short call.
